summary: Dedicated early childhood educator with over a decade of experience fostering foundational skills in diverse classroom settings. Recognized for creating engaging, developmentally appropriate learning environments within an industry-leading organization.

experience.title: Lead Preschool Teacher
bullets: Design and implement daily lesson plans focused on color, shape, number, and letter recognition for a class of 18 students.
Establish clear behavioral expectations and routines, reducing classroom disruptions by 30% over one academic year.
Adapt instructional methods and materials to accommodate varying developmental needs, including individualized learning plans.
Facilitate parent-teacher conferences twice yearly to discuss developmental progress and suggest home learning strategies.
Organize field trips and hands-on activities such as arts and crafts, music, and storytelling to promote physical and social development.

experience.title: Preschool Teacher
bullets: Taught personal hygiene and social skills through interactive games and daily routines, improving self-care independence in 85% of students.
Provided diverse learning materials for imaginative play and exploration, including sensory bins and building blocks.
Served meals and snacks in accordance with nutritional guidelines while attending to basic needs such as feeding and diapering.
Monitored student progress and maintained detailed records to inform instruction and share with guardians.
Led group activities including music, storytelling, and outdoor games to support mental and physical growth.

experience.title: Assistant Preschool Teacher
bullets: Supported lead teacher in delivering basic skills instruction, including number and letter recognition activities.
Enforced classroom rules and procedures to maintain a safe and orderly environment.
Assisted with meal service and hygiene routines, including feeding and changing as needed.
Prepared materials for arts and crafts, storytelling, and hands-on learning centers.
Observed and documented student interactions to help tailor teaching methods to individual needs.

experience.title: Early Childhood Teacher Aide
bullets: Assisted in implementing daily activities that promoted social, emotional, and cognitive development.
Helped supervise indoor and outdoor play, ensuring safety and positive peer interactions.
Aided in maintaining a clean and organized classroom with age-appropriate resources.
Supported lead teachers with classroom management and preparation of instructional materials.
Participated in parent-teacher meetings to discuss children's progress and needs.

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Early Childhood Education
